title: Implement FT-006 Plant history HTTP routes and integrated evidence
verify: Protected FT-006 routes match Plant History HTTP card/list response shapes, cursor/limit/source_type query behavior, no-store response, UUID/timestamp/enum handling, and stable error envelope.

API tests prove ActorContext is resolved before projection reads and that active normal read plus archived retained-history read enforce Boss/Engineer/Consultant grant semantics without existence leaks.
Integrated flow proves an authorized user creates check-in, measurement, and photo evidence, receives history entries with safe refs, archives the Plant, and Boss can still read retained history.
Authority tests prove orphan timeline events, photo manifests, UI Feed content, and agent text do not create or mutate history/card output.
FT-006 docs remain synchronized without claiming raw export packages, PWA UI, Vision, agents, Safety Gate, tasks/follow-up, Companion, or dataset completion.
evidence_required: integrated active and archived retained-history evidence
durable FT-006 docs sync diff summary
constraints: Use the Plant history service from TASK-023; do not implement projection logic directly in route handlers.
Expose only FT-006 Plant history card/list routes; do not implement raw export packages, PWA UI, Vision, agents, Safety Gate, tasks/follow-up, Companion, or dataset behavior.
Return no-leak denials for missing, unauthorized, revoked, wrong-Farm, disabled, or archived-without-retained-history paths.
Responses, logs, screenshots, exports, and evidence must omit auth material, absolute paths, raw SQL, provider payloads, hidden reasoning, raw chat, and unapproved governance content.
invariants: ActorContext must resolve before FT-006 route projection reads.
Plant card/history output reads PostgreSQL/read model, not timeline replay or presentation artifacts.
Archived retained-history reads grant no state-advancing authority.
Timeline refs remain audit/export refs and never become runtime authority.
verification_targets: Inspect generated OpenAPI for documented FT-006 routes, response shapes, pagination query parameters, and errors.
Trace FT-006-BHV-001 through FT-006-BHV-003 to concrete API/integration tests.
purpose: Expose the completed FT-006 Plant history projection through protected HTTP routes and prove retained active/archived history behavior end to end.
success_outcome: FT-006 is implementable as a backend feature: protected history routes return safe Plant card/history refs from PostgreSQL source rows, preserve timeline as audit/export only, and retain archived history for authorized actors without closing downstream UI or agent features.
anti_goals: No raw timeline export package or export UI.
No Plant operations write, photo upload, Vision, agent, Safety Gate, task/follow-up, Companion, dataset, or PWA implementation.
No new persistent history table or event-sourcing framework.
No feature lifecycle overclaim beyond FT-006 backend history HTTP.

forbidden_scope: raw timeline export package or export UI
Plant operations write, photo upload, Vision, agent, Safety Gate, task/follow-up, Companion, dataset, or PWA behavior
new persistent history table or event-sourcing framework
claiming raw export, PWA, Vision, agent, Safety Gate, task/follow-up, Companion, or dataset feature completion
stop_conditions: TASK-023-T3-FT-006-W1 is not done or its service contract is contradicted.
TASK-022-T3-FT-005-W2 is not done and integrated photo/history route evidence cannot be produced.
HTTP implementation requires changing public FT-006 route shapes, pagination semantics, or error semantics not covered by canonical specs.
Authorization parity cannot be proven across service and API boundaries.
Integrated evidence would claim downstream export/PWA/agent/safety/task/governance/dataset behavior.
Diagnostics or evidence contain credentials, auth material, absolute local paths, raw SQL errors, provider payloads, hidden reasoning, raw chat, or unapproved governance content.
